0.original: Zukin is a Kojin with a new purpose for old chests.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Inspect octopus traps near the <hex:021A020203>Adventure<hex:021A020103> and obtain an octopus.

25.original: Deliver the giant koromo octopus to Zukin.

48.original: We had some old treasure chests that were lying around, gathering dust. With some creativity on my part, I was able to convert them into octopus traps. And they work exceptionally well, if I may say so myself.

49.original: Now, I've a mind to gift the good folk of Kokajiya with a fresh catch, and I should be grateful if you could go out and inspect the traps.

50.original: I've laid three over by the wreck southwest of here. One is bound to have caught an octopus by now. My thanks in advance, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

51.original: There is nothing in this chest.

52.original: There is a mess of writhing tentacles in the chest!

53.original: Ah, there you are. Did the kami bless us with a catch?

54.original: Oho, such a large and lively octopus! Our blacksmith friends shall be pleased!

55.original: By the way, did I mention that older chests wreathed in weeds make the best traps? Well, they do. You may wish to remember this for your future reference.
